name: slipway
description: Scaffold a complete, working new project in ~/Dev from a project idea — interview-only LLM, script-made files. Front-loaded interview with inference (modules, RN/Expo vs native SwiftUI, macOS window vs menu-bar AND direct vs Mac-App-Store distribution, codename with 3 options, bundle prefix, GitHub org, design reference, 1Password account+vault), then scaffold.sh renders ~120 templates: pnpm/Turborepo monorepo, Next.js latest with security headers + AI SDK v7 (pinned ^7 on web AND api) + /api/health + syd1 Vercel config, full BP §9 auth (email-code sign-in, JWT + rotating refresh tokens, Resend + React Email templates, dev login gated server-side to non-prod), allowlisted admin console on a separate trust domain, APNs push over HTTP/2 (atlas pattern), optional NestJS (SWC dev/prod parity, jest+@swc/jest), SwiftUI macOS/iOS via XcodeGen with fastlane TestFlight lanes on the App Store Connect API plus sign/notarize/dmg scripts, Expo app (modules only, never EAS) with Maestro flows, Playwright e2e harness, Rust cross-OS core crate, design tokens with drift gate, Caddy + hosts + docker-compose dev env, tsgo typecheck everywhere (never tsc/ts-node), 1Password-seeded .env.local with op:// resolution, git init, install, and the gate run green — then the launch pipeline: background Dossier deep research (read in full, exported to docs/deep-research) grounding seeded feature briefs in features-to-triage, OVERVIEW.md + MARKETING-FEATURES.md with an evidence-based pricing recommendation, comprehensive mocks for every surface/flow/state via design-craft + ux-craft + mac-design-studio with a media-gen-pro icon set and 48px icon audit, a premium GSAP/three.js single-page marketing site held to a zero-slop-tells + Core-Web-Vitals bar with create-luke-content copy and interactive mock slices, and a launch-operations pack (domains, legal drafts, App Store kit, analytics schema).
